verdict.rationale: Lindy's own Routines feature documents running recurring work on a set schedule, and daily briefs imply recurring scheduled runs. So scheduled automation exists as a first-party capability. Nothing in the evidence shows cron-style expressions or any timezone control, so only the basic scheduling part of the story is covered. Missing for 10: cron-style schedule syntax, timezone configuration, detailed scheduling docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run workflows on cron-style schedules with timezone control

citations.quote: Lindy routines turn your recurring work into hands-off automation — set a schedule or trigger once, and Lindy runs the whole job for you on autopilot
Lindy can send you a daily brief on anything you prompt it to cover.
